title: Pack odd-prime Round2 terminal state
objective: Extend the exact packed Round2 terminal state from p=2 to odd word primes and reduce vector429 p=3 and p=5 local runtime without fixture-specific branches

oracles: forced exact generic FLINT Round2 payload
exceptions: Extend the existing audited FLINT/GMP packed order representation primitive only; no fixture-specific branch

handoff.summary: Extended the terminal degree-at-most-64 Round-2 state from p=2 to odd word primes whose square fits a limb. The exact internal multiplication tensor now remains in packed p-adic limbs, consumes two certified digits per enlargement, publishes compact mod-p and mod-p-squared tables, and replays from an immutable exact prime-boundary checkpoint if its four-digit margin is reached. On degree-64 vector429, p=3 falls from 2.181s to 1.478s (1.476x) and p=5 from 0.852s to 0.699s (1.218x); together with p=2 at 0.604s the three local components total 2.781s. Vector010 remains 1.840x PARI. The p=3 and p=5 payloads agree byte-for-byte with forced exact FLINT, 32 mixed-prime randomized payloads agree, and ASan/UBSan lifecycle execution passes.
risks: The packed path is intentionally terminal-prime, degree-at-most-64, and limited to primes at most 251; every unsupported boundary retains the exact generic FLINT tensor path.
Linux x64 exact differential and sanitizer execution passed. The final integration platform matrix must exercise native Windows x64, Linux arm64, and macOS arm64 before release.
